func TestClientGeneratesThroughStrictConfidentialContract(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, request.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/api/v1/prompts/execute-confidential", request.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "secret-token", request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		var payload map[string]any
		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload))
		require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherResponseTemplateCode, payload["template_code"])
		require.NotContains(t, payload, "provider_code")
		require.NotContains(t, payload, "response_schema_code")
		variables := payload["variables"].(map[string]any)
		require.ElementsMatch(t,
			[]string{"teacher_profile", "teaching_plan", "student_context", "dialog_context"},
			mapKeys(variables),
		)
		teacherProfile := variables["teacher_profile"].(map[string]any)
		soul := teacherProfile["soul"].(map[string]any)
		require.Equal(t, domain.DefaultTeacherSoulPersonaCode, soul["persona_code"])
		require.NotContains(t, soul, "student_id")
		dialogContext := variables["dialog_context"].(map[string]any)
		require.NotContains(t, dialogContext, "lesson_context")
		studentContext := variables["student_context"].(map[string]any)
		codeContext := studentContext["code_context"].(map[string]any)
		require.Equal(t, "main.go", codeContext["files"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["path"])
		require.NotContains(t, codeContext, "sandbox_id")
		require.NotContains(t, codeContext, "answer_id")
		validation := codeContext["validation"].(map[string]any)
		require.Equal(t, false, validation["available"])
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{
			"execution_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
			"idempotency_key":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
			"template_code":"teacher.response.v1","template_version":3,
			"provider_code":"openai","provider_model":"teacher-model","language_code":"ru",
			"response_schema_code":"teacher.response.v1","parsed_response":{"body":"Проверь условие цикла."},
			"cached":false,"created_at":"2026-08-31T10:00:00Z","expires_at":"2026-09-01T10:00:00Z"
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "secret-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	response, err := client.Generate(context.Background(), validGenerationRequest(t, now))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "Проверь условие цикла.", response.Body)
	require.False(t, response.Cached)
}

func TestClientProjectsOnlyModeSpecificVerifiedLessonFields(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		mode domain.LessonMessageMode
	}{
		{mode: domain.LessonMessageModeOverview},
		{mode: domain.LessonMessageModeSelection},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(string(tt.mode), func(t *testing.T) {
			now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
				var payload map[string]any
				require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload))
				variables := payload["variables"].(map[string]any)
				dialogContext := variables["dialog_context"].(map[string]any)
				lesson := dialogContext["lesson_context"].(map[string]any)
				require.Equal(t, domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion, lesson["schema"])
				require.Equal(t, string(tt.mode), lesson["mode"])
				require.Equal(t, "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", lesson["course_id"])
				require.Equal(t, "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb", lesson["section_id"])
				require.NotContains(t, lesson, "description")
				require.NotContains(t, lesson, "objectives")
				if tt.mode == domain.LessonMessageModeOverview {
					require.Equal(t, "Ошибки", lesson["title"])
					require.Equal(t, "Краткое введение", lesson["excerpt"])
					require.NotContains(t, lesson, "selected_text")
				} else {
					require.Equal(t, "errors.Is", lesson["selected_text"])
					require.NotContains(t, lesson, "title")
					require.NotContains(t, lesson, "excerpt")
				}
				writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{
					"execution_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
					"idempotency_key":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
					"template_code":"teacher.response.v1","template_version":3,
					"provider_code":"openai","provider_model":"teacher-model","language_code":"ru",
					"response_schema_code":"teacher.response.v1","parsed_response":{"body":"Ответ."},
					"cached":false,"created_at":"2026-08-31T10:00:00Z","expires_at":"2026-09-01T10:00:00Z"
				}`))
			}))
			defer server.Close()

			client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "secret-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
			_, err := client.Generate(context.Background(), lessonGenerationRequest(t, now, tt.mode))
			require.NoError(t, err)
		})
	}
}

func TestClientProjectsOnlySafeTeacherValidationExplanationAndCorrelation(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		var payload map[string]any
		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload))
		student := payload["variables"].(map[string]any)["student_context"].(map[string]any)
		practice := student["practice_task"].(map[string]any)
		validation := practice["validation_explanation"].(map[string]any)
		require.ElementsMatch(t,
			[]string{"schema", "submission_id", "workspace_digest", "updated_at", "passed", "teacher_explanation"},
			mapKeys(validation),
		)
		require.Equal(t, domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContextSchemaV1, validation["schema"])
		require.Equal(t, "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", validation["submission_id"])
		require.Equal(t, "sha256:"+strings.Repeat("a", 64), validation["workspace_digest"])
		explanation := validation["teacher_explanation"].(map[string]any)
		require.ElementsMatch(t,
			[]string{"schema", "passed", "blocking_issues", "truncated", "source_digest"}, mapKeys(explanation),
		)
		issue := explanation["blocking_issues"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)
		require.ElementsMatch(t,
			[]string{"code", "message", "hint", "file", "line", "column", "stage_id", "engine", "severity"}, mapKeys(issue),
		)
		for _, forbidden := range []string{"raw", "evidence", "stages", "errors", "selector", "route", "symbol", "rubric", "solution", "human_review", "ai_review"} {
			require.NotContains(t, validation, forbidden)
			require.NotContains(t, explanation, forbidden)
			require.NotContains(t, issue, forbidden)
		}
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{
			"execution_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
			"idempotency_key":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
			"template_code":"teacher.response.v1","template_version":3,
			"provider_code":"openai","provider_model":"teacher-model","language_code":"ru",
			"response_schema_code":"teacher.response.v1","parsed_response":{"body":"Проверь условие цикла."},
			"cached":false,"created_at":"2026-09-05T10:00:00Z","expires_at":"2026-09-06T10:00:00Z"
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	request := validGenerationRequest(t, now)
	request.Student.PracticeTask, request.Student.PracticeValidation = validPracticePromptContexts(now, request)
	client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "secret-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	_, err := client.Generate(context.Background(), request)
	require.NoError(t, err)
}

func TestClientMapsConflictWithoutLeakingResponseBody(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusConflict)
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte("private provider response must not escape"))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "secret-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	_, err := client.Generate(context.Background(), validGenerationRequest(t, time.Now().UTC()))
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherGenerationConflict)
	require.NotContains(t, err.Error(), "private provider response")
}

func TestClientReplaysCommittedResponseWithoutOriginalContext(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodGet, request.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/api/v1/prompts/confidential-executions/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", request.URL.Path)
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{
			"execution_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
			"idempotency_key":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
			"template_code":"teacher.response.v1","template_version":2,
			"provider_code":"openai","provider_model":"teacher-model","language_code":"ru",
			"response_schema_code":"teacher.response.v1","parsed_response":{"body":"replayed"},
			"cached":true,"created_at":"2026-08-31T10:00:00Z","expires_at":"2026-09-01T10:00:00Z"
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "secret-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	response, err := client.Replay(context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, response.Cached)
	require.Equal(t, "replayed", response.Body)
}

func TestClientMapsMissingReplayWithoutLeakingResponseBody(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotFound)
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte("private execution state must not escape"))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "secret-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	_, err := client.Replay(context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherGenerationNotFound)
	require.NotContains(t, err.Error(), "private execution state")
}

func TestClientSummarizesThroughExactConfidentialPairWithoutLessonSelection(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, request.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/api/v1/prompts/execute-confidential", request.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "summary-token", request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		var payload map[string]any
		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload))
		require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode, payload["template_code"])
		require.NotContains(t, payload, "response_schema_code")
		variables := payload["variables"].(map[string]any)
		require.ElementsMatch(t, []string{"scope", "prior_summary", "messages"}, mapKeys(variables))
		scope := variables["scope"].(map[string]any)
		require.Equal(t, "dialog", scope["scope_type"])
		require.Equal(t, "lesson", scope["context_type"])
		require.NotContains(t, variables, "lesson_context")
		require.NotContains(t, string(mustJSON(t, variables)), "selected lesson text")
		message := variables["messages"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)
		require.ElementsMatch(t, []string{"sequence", "author_type", "excerpt"}, mapKeys(message))
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{
			"execution_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
			"idempotency_key":"aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa",
			"template_code":"teacher.context-summary.v1","template_version":1,
			"provider_code":"openai","provider_model":"summary-model","language_code":"ru",
			"response_schema_code":"teacher.context-summary.v1",
			"parsed_response":{"schema":"teacher.context-summary.v1","summary":"Кратко.",
			"understood_observations":[],"open_difficulties":[],"assistance_observations":[],"next_focus":[]},
			"cached":false,"created_at":"2026-09-04T10:00:00Z","expires_at":"2026-09-05T10:00:00Z"
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "summary-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	payload, err := client.Summarize(context.Background(), validSummarizationRequest(now))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "Кратко.", payload.Summary)
}

func TestClientRejectsMalformedOrOversizedSummaryResult(t *testing.T) {
	responses := []string{
		`{"execution_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999","idempotency_key":"aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa","template_code":"teacher.context-summary.v1","template_version":1,"provider_code":"openai","provider_model":"summary-model","language_code":"ru","response_schema_code":"teacher.context-summary.v1","parsed_response":{"schema":"teacher.context-summary.v1","summary":"ok","understood_observations":[],"open_difficulties":[],"assistance_observations":[],"next_focus":[],"reasoning":"forbidden"},"cached":false,"created_at":"2026-09-04T10:00:00Z","expires_at":"2026-09-05T10:00:00Z"}`,
		`{"execution_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999","idempotency_key":"aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa","template_code":"teacher.context-summary.v1","template_version":1,"provider_code":"openai","provider_model":"summary-model","language_code":"ru","response_schema_code":"teacher.context-summary.v1","parsed_response":{"schema":"teacher.context-summary.v1","summary":"` + strings.Repeat("я", 4001) + `","understood_observations":[],"open_difficulties":[],"assistance_observations":[],"next_focus":[]},"cached":false,"created_at":"2026-09-04T10:00:00Z","expires_at":"2026-09-05T10:00:00Z"}`,
	}
	for _, response := range responses {
		server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
			_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(response))
		}))
		client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "summary-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
		_, err := client.Summarize(context.Background(), validSummarizationRequest(time.Now().UTC()))
		require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary)
		server.Close()
	}
}

func TestClientRejectsTeacherResponseVariablesBeyondAggregateBudget(t *testing.T) {
	request := validGenerationRequest(t, time.Now().UTC())
	request.Student.Onboarding = &domain.StudentOnboardingSnapshot{GoalText: strings.Repeat("a", domain.TeacherResponseVariablesMaximumBytes+1)}
	client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: "http://unused", InternalToken: "token", HTTPClient: http.DefaultClient}

	_, err := client.Generate(context.Background(), request)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration)
}

func TestClientIncludesStrictProvisionalSummaryInTeacherResponseContext(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		var payload map[string]any
		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload))
		dialogContext := payload["variables"].(map[string]any)["dialog_context"].(map[string]any)
		summary := dialogContext["provisional_summary"].(map[string]any)
		require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode, summary["schema"])
		require.Equal(t, float64(8), summary["covered_through_sequence"])
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{
			"execution_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999","idempotency_key":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
			"template_code":"teacher.response.v1","template_version":3,"provider_code":"openai","provider_model":"teacher-model",
			"language_code":"ru","response_schema_code":"teacher.response.v1","parsed_response":{"body":"Ответ."},"cached":false,
			"created_at":"2026-09-04T10:00:00Z","expires_at":"2026-09-05T10:00:00Z"
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	request := validGenerationRequest(t, now)
	request.PromptContext.ProvisionalSummary = &domain.TeacherContextSummaryProjection{
		Schema: domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode, PolicyVersion: domain.TeacherContextSummaryPolicyVersion,
		CoveredFromSequence: 1, CoveredThroughSequence: 8,
		Observations: domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload{
			Schema: domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode, Summary: "Prior.",
			UnderstoodObservations: []string{}, OpenDifficulties: []string{}, AssistanceObservations: []string{}, NextFocus: []string{},
		},
	}
	request.Dialog.Messages[0].MessageSequence = 9
	request.Dialog.Messages[0].LastEventSequence = 9
	request.PromptContext.Messages[0].MessageSequence = 9
	client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	_, err := client.Generate(context.Background(), request)
	require.NoError(t, err)
}

func validSummarizationRequest(_ time.Time) domain.TeacherContextSummarizationRequest {
	return domain.TeacherContextSummarizationRequest{
		IdempotencyKey: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", LanguageCode: "ru",
		Scope: domain.TeacherContextScope{
			StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", PersonalTeacherID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			DialogID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", ContextType: domain.LearningContextLesson,
			ContextID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		},
		Messages: []domain.TeacherContextMessage{{
			AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser, Body: "Что означает этот фрагмент?", MessageSequence: 7,
		}},
	}
}

func mustJSON(t *testing.T, value any) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(value)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return encoded
}

func validGenerationRequest(t *testing.T, now time.Time) domain.TeacherGenerationRequest {
	t.Helper()
	request := validDialogRequestForClient(now)
	soul, err := domain.NewTeacherSoul(
		request.PersonalTeacherID, request.StudentID, domain.DefaultTeacherSoulSettings(), now.Add(-time.Hour),
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	value, err := domain.NewTeacherGenerationRequest(domain.TeacherGenerationRequest{
		IdempotencyKey: request.EventID, LanguageCode: "ru",
		Teacher: domain.PersonalTeacher{
			ID: request.PersonalTeacherID, StudentID: request.StudentID, TeacherProfileID: "default",
			Language: "ru", CommunicationStyle: "adaptive", PedagogyProfile: "adaptive",
			HintPolicy: "progressive", InterventionMode: "balanced", Version: 1,
		},
		Soul: soul,
		Plan: domain.TeacherTeachingPlan{
			PolicyVersion: domain.TeacherDialogPolicyVersion,
			MethodCode:    domain.DefaultPedagogyMethodCode, MethodVersion: domain.ProgressiveHintMethodVersion,
			TeachingMode: domain.TeachingModePractice,
			Strategy:     "socratic", Stage: domain.AMCDOrient, Action: domain.TeacherActionGiveHint,
			HintLevel: 1, Guidance: domain.TeacherGuidanceSocraticQuestion, ReasonCode: "progressive_hint",
			ReasonSummary: "Selected first bounded hint.",
		},
		Student: domain.StudentContext{
			StudentID: request.StudentID, LearningActionID: request.LearningActionID,
			TaskID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", ContextType: request.ContextType,
			ContextID: request.ContextID,
			CodeContext: &domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContext{
				LearningActionID: request.LearningActionID, StudentID: request.StudentID,
				TaskID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", Available: true,
				Files:         []domain.StudentCodeFile{{Path: "main.go", Content: "package main"}},
				PolicyVersion: domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContextVersion,
				Validation:    domain.StudentValidationObservation{PolicyVersion: domain.SandboxValidationObservationVersion},
			},
		},
		Dialog: domain.DialogRequestContext{
			DialogID: request.DialogID, StudentID: request.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: request.PersonalTeacherID,
			ContextType: request.ContextType, ContextID: request.ContextID, SourceMessageID: request.SourceMessageID,
			LearningActionID: request.LearningActionID,
			Messages: []domain.DialogMessage{{
				ID: request.SourceMessageID, DialogID: request.DialogID, AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser,
				SenderID: request.StudentID, LearningActionID: request.LearningActionID,
				Body: "Почему тест падает?", Status: 1, MessageSequence: request.SourceSequence,
				LastEventSequence: request.EventSequence, CreatedAt: request.OccurredAt,
			}},
		},
		PromptContext: domain.TeacherPromptDialogContext{Messages: []domain.TeacherContextMessage{{
			AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser, Body: "Почему тест падает?",
			MessageSequence: request.SourceSequence, IsSource: true,
		}}},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return value
}

func validDialogRequestForClient(now time.Time) domain.DialogTeacherRequest {
	return domain.DialogTeacherRequest{
		EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		EventSequence: 4, SourceMessageID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", SourceSequence: 2,
		StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		ContextType: domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, ContextID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		LearningActionID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", OccurredAt: now.Add(-time.Minute),
	}
}

func validPracticePromptContexts(now time.Time, request domain.TeacherGenerationRequest) (*domain.PracticeTaskContext, *domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContext) {
	practice := &domain.PracticeTaskContext{
		Schema: domain.PracticeTaskContextSchemaV1, TaskInstanceID: request.Student.ContextID,
		StudentID: request.Student.StudentID, TaskRevisionID: request.Student.TaskID,
		LearningActionID: request.Student.LearningActionID, Surface: "practice", Locale: "ru", Status: "ACTIVE",
		Step: domain.PracticeTaskStepContext{ID: "implement", Title: "Implement", Objective: "Build", Status: "AVAILABLE"},
		AssistancePolicy: domain.PracticeTaskAssistancePolicy{
			Version: 1, MaxHintLevel: 2, Teacher: domain.PracticeTeacherPolicy{MayExplain: true},
		},
	}
	submissionID := "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	workspaceDigest := "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64)
	passed := false
	validation := &domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContext{
		Schema: domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContextSchemaV1, Available: true,
		TaskInstanceID: practice.TaskInstanceID, StudentID: practice.StudentID,
		TaskRevisionID: practice.TaskRevisionID, LearningActionID: practice.LearningActionID,
		SubmissionID: &submissionID, WorkspaceDigest: &workspaceDigest, UpdatedAt: &now, Passed: &passed,
		TeacherExplanation: &domain.TeacherValidationExplanation{
			Schema: domain.TeacherValidationExplanationSchemaV1, BlockingIssues: []domain.TeacherValidationIssue{{
				Code: "FAILED", Message: "Fix the loop.", Hint: "Check the bound.", File: "main.go",
				Line: 4, Column: 2, StageID: "tests", Engine: "go.core", Severity: "error",
			}},
			SourceDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64),
		},
	}
	return practice, validation
}

func lessonGenerationRequest(t *testing.T, now time.Time, mode domain.LessonMessageMode) domain.TeacherGenerationRequest {
	t.Helper()
	value := validGenerationRequest(t, now)
	value.Dialog.ContextType = domain.LearningContextLesson
	value.Dialog.LearningActionID = ""
	value.Dialog.Messages[0].LearningActionID = ""
	value.Dialog.Messages[0].LessonContext = &domain.LessonMessageContext{
		Schema: domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion, Mode: mode,
		CourseID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", LessonID: value.Dialog.ContextID,
		ContentRevision: "2026-08-31T09:00:00Z",
	}
	value.Student = domain.StudentContext{
		StudentID: value.Dialog.StudentID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextLesson, ContextID: value.Dialog.ContextID,
	}
	value.Plan.TeachingMode = domain.TeachingModeLesson
	value.Plan.Strategy = "conceptual_explanation"
	value.Plan.Stage = domain.AMCDRealize
	value.Plan.Action = domain.TeacherActionRespond
	value.Plan.HintLevel = 0
	value.Plan.Guidance = domain.TeacherGuidanceAdaptiveExplanation
	value.Plan.ReasonCode = "verified_lesson_" + string(mode)
	value.Plan.ReasonSummary = "Verified bounded lesson context."
	lesson := domain.LessonTeachingContext{
		Schema: domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion, Mode: mode,
		CourseID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", LessonID: value.Dialog.ContextID,
		SectionID: "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb", Language: "ru",
		ContentRevision: "2026-08-31T09:00:00Z",
	}
	if mode == domain.LessonMessageModeOverview {
		lesson.Title = "Ошибки"
		lesson.Excerpt = "Краткое введение"
	} else {
		lesson.SelectedText = "errors.Is"
		value.Dialog.Messages[0].LessonContext.SelectedText = lesson.SelectedText
	}
	value.Lesson = &lesson
	normalized, err := domain.NewTeacherGenerationRequest(value)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return normalized
}

func mapKeys(values map[string]any) []string {
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for key := range values {
		keys = append(keys, key)
	}
	return keys
}

type t14PromptTransport func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)

func (transport t14PromptTransport) RoundTrip(request *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	return transport(request)
}
func TestT14FrozenLessonPromptContainsSameBoundedAnchor(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	for _, mode := range []domain.LessonMessageMode{domain.LessonMessageModeOverview, domain.LessonMessageModeSelection} {
		t.Run(string(mode), func(t *testing.T) {
			value := lessonGenerationRequest(t, now, mode)
			source := value.Dialog.Messages[0].LessonContext
			source.Schema = domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersionV2
			source.ContentRevision = "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc"
			source.LearningPathID = "dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd"
			source.LearningPathItemID = "eeeeeeee-eeee-4eee-8eee-eeeeeeeeeeee"
			source.ContentDigest = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64)
			value.Lesson.Schema = source.Schema
			value.Lesson.ContentRevision = source.ContentRevision
			value.Lesson.LearningPathID = source.LearningPathID
			value.Lesson.LearningPathItemID = source.LearningPathItemID
			value.Lesson.ContentDigest = source.ContentDigest
			value.Lesson.Language = ""
			value.Lesson.SectionID = ""
			called := false
			client := aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: "http://prompt.invalid", InternalToken: "internal-test-token", HTTPClient: &http.Client{Transport: t14PromptTransport(func(request *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
				called = true
				var payload map[string]any
				require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload))
				lesson := payload["variables"].(map[string]any)["dialog_context"].(map[string]any)["lesson_context"].(map[string]any)
				require.Equal(t, source.Schema, lesson["schema"])
				require.Equal(t, source.LearningPathID, lesson["learning_path_id"])
				require.Equal(t, source.LearningPathItemID, lesson["learning_path_item_id"])
				require.Equal(t, source.ContentDigest, lesson["content_digest"])
				require.Equal(t, source.ContentRevision, lesson["content_revision"])
				require.NotContains(t, lesson, "content")
				require.NotContains(t, lesson, "description")
				require.NotContains(t, lesson, "language")
				require.NotContains(t, lesson, "section_id")
				if mode == domain.LessonMessageModeOverview {
					require.Equal(t, value.Lesson.Title, lesson["title"])
					require.Equal(t, value.Lesson.Excerpt, lesson["excerpt"])
					require.NotContains(t, lesson, "selected_text")
				} else {
					require.Equal(t, source.SelectedText, lesson["selected_text"])
					require.NotContains(t, lesson, "title")
					require.NotContains(t, lesson, "excerpt")
				}
				return &http.Response{StatusCode: http.StatusServiceUnavailable, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(""))}, nil
			})}}
			_, err := client.Generate(context.Background(), value)
			require.Error(t, err)
			require.True(t, called)
			for _, field := range []string{"path", "item", "digest"} {
				copyValue := value
				copyLesson := *value.Lesson
				copyValue.Lesson = &copyLesson
				switch field {
				case "path":
					copyLesson.LearningPathID = source.LearningPathItemID
				case "item":
					copyLesson.LearningPathItemID = source.LearningPathID
				case "digest":
					copyLesson.ContentDigest = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64)
				}
				_, err := domain.NewTeacherGenerationRequest(copyValue)
				require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration)
			}
		})
	}
}
